Q: How to conditionally add libraries intp pc.in file A:

while your solution might work, it sounds overly complicated to me.

instead I would do:

in configure.ac

PCLIBS="-lmylib"
AS_IF([test "${optioan_a} = "true"],[PCLIBS="${PCLIBS} -lmyliboption-a"])
AS_IF([test "${optioan_b} = "true"],[PCLIBS="${PCLIBS} -lmyliboption-b"])
AS_IF([test "${optioan_c} = "true"],[PCLIBS="${PCLIBS} -lmyliboption-c"])
AC_SUBST([PC_LIBS])


AC_CONFIG_FILES([library.pc])
dnl ...

and in your library.pc.in:

Libs: -L${libdir} @PCLIBS@
